entities.summary: Isaiah Piñeiro is a Puerto Rican professional basketball player for Cangrejeros de Santurce of the Baloncesto Superior Nacional (BSN) and the Puerto Rican national team. Standing at a height of 6 ft 7 in (2.01 m), he plays the small forward and power forward positions.
